steps.content: With the clear sky reflected on the lake, it's like the tips of Hamel's toes are tapping the sky when they're tapping the water.

Her movements have an elegant rhythm to them, playing a song on the soundless stage of the lake. The dance has a special charm that makes it impossible for the audience to look away, sweeping away all their depressing thoughts.

The white dress and water-blue long hair stream across each other, and the dense mist flows with their movements, forming a vague illusion gradually, enveloping her. Vaguely, you hear continuous whispers.

steps.speaker: Faint Voice
steps.content: The show has begun... Hamel is dancing for us...

steps.speaker: Faint Voice
steps.content: So beautiful... So warm... Am I home... Am I dreaming?

steps.speaker: Faint Voice
steps.content: Touch me, Hamel... Let me feel that I still exist...
Hamel doesn't answer. Her arms draw beautiful curves, gently caressing the fairies approaching her. The illusions' quivering wails slowly subside.

The chaotic parade, the lurking contamination, and the cruel Black Ring shrouding everything are all gone. Such beauty is just like an all-accepting kindness. It's as if just by staring at her, you can gain eternal happiness.
Give my companions back to me.
Hamel doesn't respond and keeps twirling. It's as if she can't hear your voice.
You walk forward, treading on the lake like treading on the reflected sky, carrying the rings of ripples as you make your way to the Dancer at the center of the lake.

steps.speaker: Faint Voice
steps.content: Who are you? Why are you intruding on her stage? Why are you disturbing Hamel?
The mist is gradually stirring, gathering to form one mascot after another. They put themselves between you and Hamel, pushing and pulling at you to banish you.

steps.speaker: Faint Voice
steps.content: Go back, human! Don't come near Hamel! Don't you dare harm Hamel!
Refusing to back off, you reach out your hand and prepare to fight using the shackles' power. At the moment the shackles get activated, water splashes up, and two familiar figures emerge before you.
The illusions remain silent. Despite their insubstantial form, they still shield you with their bodies.
